note: A dossier for the authorized product owner. It states what each decision would do and what it depends on. It decides nothing, ratifies nothing and carries no approval.
separation: A product ratification fixes a product-specification baseline only. It cannot issue an institutional permission, mandate, office, delegation or authority decision, and it changes no implementation, security, release or runtime status.

options.title: Distinct persona with an independent action universe
Scoped profile of Representative 2.2 with its own presentation profile and acceptance profile

stewardStructure.effectOfRecommendation: The recommendation is not a selection. If the product owner selects another option, the Steward package is returned or rejected rather than approved as written.
stewardStructure.changesBaselineProposal: The proposed Steward baseline (DEC-PD-01 option 1) treats Steward as its own persona. Option C keeps the Steward contracts and the Steward package as a reviewable unit, and changes how the package is ratified and owned: the Representative 2.2 package is the authority universe and the Steward package is a profile of it.

ratificationOrder.dependency: The Steward structure decision and DEC-PD-01 are listed by more than one persona record, and DEC-PD-0C2-10 asks for the order of product acceptance.
